content: Replenish of execution budget by expiry point Upstream requirements: SRS_Os_00098 An expiry point shall contain a (possibly empty) set of Tasks s to replenish their exe- cution budget. The replenishment is allowed only for tasks with OsTaskTimingPro- tectionDeferrableServer = TRUE and is done by means of BudgetReplenish (see [SWS_Os_91035])
